tasks.summary: Internet offer retrieval covers Iliad, Fastweb, TIM, Sky Wifi, PosteCasa, EOLO, Tiscali, CoopVoce, Kena and Dimensione. This is not all Italian national, local and virtual providers. Vodafone product HTML, ho. catalog text and spusu's home text were not readable by the native parser; 1Mobile returned client-side template placeholders. WINDTRE served a bot-block page and Very product pages redirected to anti-bot validation. BBBell and Enel have readable residential pages grouping multiple variants and conditional prices, which the current one-product-per-page adapter cannot represent faithfully. AGCOM's central comparison prototype is restricted to operators and consumer associations, and its registration directory is not an offer catalog. Insurance product retrieval covers Bene and Allianz.
tasks.nextStep: Continue source-specific adapters for national, local and virtual operators using their active official product or tariff-transparency pages. For BBBell, parse individual residential variants and their conditions before adding offers. Keep blocked pages as explicit gaps. Never infer an offer or price from registration alone.
